Construction
The mark is not drawn at random. Each petal is formed by the shared intersection of four circles.
1
Four circles
Ø218 circles whose centres form a square with 109px sides.
2
One petal
The shared intersection of all four — an 80×80 squircle.
3
Four petals
In a 180×180 area, 20px apart, with a cross-shaped gap in the centre.
Meaning of the mark
Four overlapping areas
The mark refers to the popular four-circle Ikigai model: what you love, what you are good at, what the world needs and what you can be paid for. The answer lies where the circles overlap — the four petals of the mark are exactly those over
